summary: Sonnet vision comparison of the Windows cpp/xaml gallery vs the MAUI reference, per page
logs: judging 16 diff pages with Sonnet vision
judged 16 pages · 14 have real port diffs

port_diffs: Border background: cpp/xaml render a flat/unfilled background instead of MAUI's linear gradient fill from #00B4DB (start) to #0083B0 (end) across the Border content area — the LinearGradientBrush is not being applied to the border's background.

Border stroke: cpp/xaml render the yellow border as a solid continuous line; MAUI renders it as a dashed/dotted stroke per StrokeDashArray '1,1' — the dash pattern is not applied to the border stroke on Windows.

Picker controls (xaml only): 'Border Content' and 'Border Shape' Pickers show their placeholder title text instead of the selected item ('Label' and 'RoundRectangle' respectively, as MAUI shows) — the picker's SelectedItem/initial value is not being displayed.

Capture/gallery state mismatch: cpp render shows the page mid/post-drag-and-drop (top 'All colors' row is missing the Red swatch, 'Rainbow' list already contains a dropped Red swatch, and all three 'relative to...' status labels plus 'Move:' are filled in with drag/drop coordinates) instead of the pristine initial state MAUI shows (7 swatches in top row, empty Rainbow list, all status labels blank, 'Move: (none yet)') — the capture script or gallery page for this cpp build is not resetting/re-navigating to a fresh DragAndDropPage instance before the screenshot is taken.

Top 'All colors' DragGestureRecognizer swatch list: cpp is missing the Red swatch entirely (only Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Purple/Indigo, Violet remain) versus MAUI's full 7-swatch list (Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Indigo, Violet) — restore the full swatch set in the idle/initial capture.

Image control fails to load/decode the source photo (pug.jpg) on Windows — both cpp and xaml renders show a flat light-gray placeholder rectangle instead of the actual photo that MAUI displays, in the 'Image' section and in all three 'Clipped Image using ...Geometry' sections.

Because the image never loads, the RectangleGeometry/RoundRectangleGeometry/EllipseGeometry clip shapes cannot be visually verified — the clip mask is applied to a blank gray box instead of the photo, so rounded-corner and ellipse clipping edges are indistinguishable from the plain rectangle in the port renders.
Scale=2 Label: xaml renders it as a plain unscaled button in the vertical stack instead of applying a Scale transform to enlarge it and overlay/rotate across the Rotation=20 element as MAUI does.
Rotation=20 Label: xaml does not apply the 20-degree rotation transform — it stays as a flat, unrotated bar/button in the list instead of the diagonal rotated strip MAUI renders.

IsClippedToBounds rectangle: xaml draws the green rounded rectangle as an unfilled outline (thick green stroke, transparent/background-colored interior) but MAUI (and cpp) render it as a solid filled light-green rectangle with no visible border.
Buttons/Labels ('Scale = 1', 'Scale = 2', 'Rotation = 20', 'Lorem ipsum...'): xaml renders all text in bold weight; MAUI uses regular (non-bold) font weight throughout.

Overall vertical rhythm: because the Scale/Rotation transforms are not applied, xaml's stack is far more compact/uniform than MAUI's, which has large gaps caused by the transformed (scaled/rotated) elements overlapping neighboring content.
verdicts.root_control: label (transform: Scale/Rotation not applied) and rectangle (fill vs stroke)

port_diffs: SwipeView rows: cpp render's rows are pushed slightly further right/down than MAUI's due to a larger left/top inset on the first row only (minor, likely within allowed outer-padding tolerance but worth checking row 1 alignment matches rows 2-5).

CollectionView (header/footer container): an unwanted background photo (dog/lamb image) fills the header and footer bands entirely; MAUI's render shows a plain solid page background with no image at all — remove/fix the ImageSource being applied as a background to the header/footer area.

CollectionView layout: header and footer are rendered back-to-back at the top of the page with zero gap; MAUI places the header at the very top and the footer much lower (near the bottom, right above the two action buttons), implying the CollectionView's empty-list area is stretching to fill the remaining vertical space between header and footer in MAUI but is collapsing to zero height in the port.

Footer text 'This Is A Footer' renders at a slight rotation/skew in both cpp and xaml captures; MAUI renders it perfectly horizontal — check for an erroneous transform (rotation) being applied to the footer label.

Header/footer label text color: port renders header/footer text as opaque cream/tan; MAUI renders the same text notably lighter/more translucent (near-white with low contrast against light background in light mode) — verify the text color or opacity matches MAUI's actual value rather than the port's solid tan.

Slider (Content Height demo) initializes to its minimum value (40, thumb at far-left) instead of MAUI's default of 60 (thumb centered) — check the Slider's default Value binding/initial value wiring in the cpp port.
Because the Slider value is wrong, the 'Content height:' label reads 40 instead of 60, and the three bottom Border content areas render shorter than MAUI's (height driven off the wrong slider value).

Header/Footer Label ('This Is A Header' / 'This Is A Footer') is missing MAUI's rotation/skew transform — MAUI renders this text visibly rotated (angled, italic-like) while cpp and xaml render it perfectly horizontal.

Header and Footer Grid rows show a large photo (dog image) filling the band background in cpp/xaml; MAUI's header/footer band has a flat page-background color with no image at all — remove the image background to match MAUI.
Header/footer text weight looks bolder/heavier in cpp and xaml than MAUI's lighter-weight header/footer text.

In dark mode, the 'Add Content' button bar directly below the header appears full-width flush with no visible top divider/border in cpp/xaml, while MAUI shows a subtle top border separating it from the header band — check border/separator styling on the toolbar row.
Animated GIF ImageButton renders as a solid black box instead of loading/playing the actual animated GIF image that MAUI shows.

Because the Animated GIF section fails to render its content, the page never scrolls into view the 'Use Online Source' button and 'Background (toggle)' section that are visible in MAUI's viewport — verify the GIF loads so page layout/height matches MAUI and those trailing controls become visible.
MAUI reference capture (light and dark) is stuck on the MAUI_COMPARE_PAGE picker list instead of navigating to the tabbed_flyout page — capture harness bug, not comparable as ground truth.

cpp TabbedPage/FlyoutPage renders only a bare top tab strip ('Home'/'Settings') with an entirely empty content area; MAUI's actual page (per xaml capture) shows three stacked bars ('Home tab', 'Settings tab', 'Toggle flyout') plus body text 'Flyout dismissed' and 'This is the Home tab.' — the cpp port is missing the toggle-flyout button and the status/content labels entirely.

cpp TabbedPage in light mode uses a native pill-style top tab bar (blue selected text, white unselected tab background) that does not match MAUI's flat full-width bar-of-buttons style seen in the xaml capture (light gray bars with centered black text, no tab-pill chrome).

cpp dark mode content area renders solid black (#1a1a1a-ish near-black, looks like an unstyled/undrawn surface) instead of MAUI's dark gray page background (~#1c1c1c region below the bars) with visible text content — content region appears completely blank/undrawn rather than just uninitialized-content dark.

cpp is missing the FlyoutPage flyout affordance altogether — MAUI's xaml capture shows a 'Toggle flyout' bar/button as the third row; cpp shows only two top tabs and nothing else, so the flyout toggle control was not ported/rendered for this page.

Entry with VisualStateManager (top entry) renders with a solid bright green fill background in both light and dark mode; MAUI shows no green fill at all — just the entry's normal (white/dark) background with a thin red/orange underline border. The VisualStateManager Normal-state trigger for background color is being applied/rendered incorrectly (or a Focused/invalid-state color is leaking into Normal state) — should match MAUI's unfilled entry with colored bottom border only.

MAUI's first Entry shows a colored underline/border only (orange in dark, red-ish in light) with no fill; the port fills the entire entry box with solid green in both themes, which is a much larger and more prominent color block than MAUI intends.

MAUI reference capture for title_bar shows the page-picker list ("Set MAUI_COMPARE_PAGE to one of...") instead of the actual title_bar demo — the MAUI capture harness failed to navigate to the target page, so no real content comparison against ground truth is possible for this page.

Not a port bug: both cpp and xaml renders correctly show the title_bar demo (Content Options / Color Options with Set Icon, Title/Subtitle fields, Leading/Content/Trailing checkboxes, Tall TitleBar, Show TitleBar, Color Options with Green swatches and Set Color/Set Foreground buttons) and are pixel-identical to each other in both light and dark mode — re-capture the MAUI reference to get a real baseline.
verdicts.root_control: none — MAUI reference capture is the wrong page (capture harness navigation failure, not a port control issue)

port_diffs: CollectionView item rows: MAUI renders each row with visible checkbox-style selection indicators (a bordered checkbox square, filled/checked with a red checkmark for selected items Item 1 and Item 2); cpp/xaml render plain text rows with no checkbox glyphs at all.
CollectionView selected-row background: MAUI highlights selected rows (Item 1, Item 2) with a light red/pink selection background band; cpp/xaml show no selection background highlight on any row.

CollectionView row height/spacing: MAUI's item rows are compact (tight ~20px row height, items packed directly under the header); cpp/xaml rows have noticeably larger vertical spacing between 'This is the header' and 'Item 0', and between each subsequent item.

Buttons ('Clear and Add', 'Reset', 'Direct Update') position: MAUI places the three buttons directly below the 4-item list (list ends around y=160, buttons start ~y=165); cpp/xaml push the buttons far down the page (starting ~y=470) because the CollectionView is rendered as an unbounded/expanded list region instead of being sized to its content.

Page/ContentPage background: MAUI light renders a white page background (including the empty area below the 'Ready — tap a layer set below' status text); both cpp and xaml render a light-gray background there instead — background color should match MAUI's white.
